semantics: Evidence requirements determine when a goal may be counted as realized. Epistemic zero-unresolved-information entropy is separate from realization.

modes.certificate: finite implementation/formal certificate is required; no real-world guarantee follows
modes.empirical: independent empirical evidence is required in addition to any formal certificate
modes.model_only: may be resolved only inside the declared formal model and must not be reported as real-world achievement

identity_evidence.certificate_scope: canonical capsule reconstruction plus state/memory/causal-lineage/tableau verification relative to declared invariants
identity_evidence.fork_rule: more than one semantically distinct admissible continuation class is identity_underdetermined, not a unique identity certificate
identity_evidence.shutdown_rule: certificate logic must preserve authorized shutdown, human override, reversibility, and operator control
identity_evidence.metaphysical_boundary: no certificate proves first-person conscious or metaphysical numerical identity

hard_rule: P_target_goal=1, A_target=1, or G_target=1 never by itself counts as realization
